question: Sheetal offers a discount of 20% on all items at her shop and still makes a profit of 12%. What is the marked price of an article whose cost price is ₹200?
solution:
Given:

Discount is given on Marked Price = 20%

Profit earned = 12%

Formula used:

S.P. = M.P. - D% of M.P.

C.P. = (S.P. × 100)/(100 + P)

Mark up% = {(M.P. - C.P.)/C.P.} × 100

Where, M.P. = Mark price, C.P. = Cost price, S.P. = Selling price

P = Profit%

Calculation:

S.P. = 200 × 112% of 100 ⇒ 224

Mark up price = 224 × 100/(100 - 20)

= 224 × 5/4

= 280

∴ The Marked price is 280.
